intent: Individually authored singular/plural listeners, emphatic action, same-person reminders, automatic door experiment and nearby-reference tasks. Original draft transfer; guided work gives no independent or hearing credit.
picturePurpose: Original two-panel cape-making contrast supports a real tap decision between pupils doing the making and watching an adult. Code supplies exact roles and labels. A separate coded door experiment changes the closing cause while keeping bystanders fixed.

workshop.title: 谁亲自动手，动作又回到谁？
workshop.instruction: 圈人物、比较制作场景，再松手观察门会不会自己关上。

items.label: yourself：只对一位听者说
items.prompt: Ms Li tells Ming alone to leave enough rest time. Amy is not being addressed. Tap the person meant by yourself.

wordDecision.prompt: Ms Li tells Ming alone to leave enough rest time. Amy is not being addressed. Tap the person meant by yourself.

recordPaths.label: 省略的you与反身代词指同一人

recordSelection.title: 点出要给自己留时间的人
recordSelection.prompt: Ms Li只对Ming提出休息建议；Amy没被叫到。
recordSelection.wrong: 只选Ming；老师是说话者，Amy不在这次请求内。
recordSelection.quote: Give yourself enough time to rest.

items.material: Give yourself enough time to rest.
items.reason: 祈使句Give省略了主语you。老师只对Ming说，you与yourself都指Ming：给自己留出休息时间。yourself用于单数的你自己；若同时对多人说，用yourselves。不是让Ming给老师留时间。

options.text: Ms Li: the teacher who is speaking.
options.reason: yourself跟随听者，不是说话的老师自己。

options.text: Ming: the one listener leaves time for himself.
options.reason: 请求只面向Ming，yourself指单数听者自己。

options.text: Ming and Amy: use yourselves for both.
options.reason: 题目只对Ming说，不能把未被告知的Amy加进来。

items.label: himself：强调是他亲手做的
items.prompt: Ben is a boy. He personally built the shelf using a plan. Leo bought a ready-made one. Tap who himself emphasizes.

wordDecision.prompt: Ben is a boy. He personally built the shelf using a plan. Leo bought a ready-made one. Tap who himself emphasizes.

recordPaths.label: 看动作由谁亲自完成
steps: a plan is a resource, not the maker

recordSelection.title: 点出亲手做架子的人
recordSelection.prompt: Ben按图纸亲手制作；Leo买了一个现成架子。

rows.label: Ben
rows.text: A boy; built the shelf from a plan.

recordSelection.hint: himself指制作的Ben，不指架子或买架子的Leo。
recordSelection.wrong: 应选Ben；himself强调他本人完成制作。

items.material: He built the little shelf himself.
items.reason: He和himself都指男孩Ben。这里himself作强调语，突出是他亲自做的；去掉himself，He built the little shelf仍是完整句子。使用图纸或工具不影响这一强调。不要把himself当成架子，也不要用宾格him替代。
items.hint: himself强调他亲自做；不等于不能用工具。

options.text: The shelf: it built something.
options.reason: 架子是被做出来的物，不是himself强调的人。

options.text: Ben could not use any plan or tools.
options.reason: himself不表示禁止使用图纸或工具，强调的是由他亲自做。

options.text: Ben: he did the building personally.
options.reason: himself强调Ben亲自做架子；使用图纸不改变这一点。

items.label: herself：提醒者与被提醒者相同
items.prompt: Mia is a girl. She writes herself a reminder to check a label. Ben only reports it. Tap both roles’ shared person.

wordDecision.prompt: Mia is a girl. She writes herself a reminder to check a label. Ben only reports it. Tap both roles’ shared person.

recordPaths.label: 把提醒的箭头接回本人

recordSelection.title: 点出既提醒又被提醒的人
recordSelection.prompt: 女孩Mia给自己写提醒；Ben只在转述这件事。

rows.label: Mia
rows.text: A girl; reminds the same person: Mia.

rows.label: Amy
rows.text: Receives no reminder in this event.

recordSelection.hint: 沿着提醒的动作，发出者和接收者都是Mia。
recordSelection.wrong: 只选Mia；Ben在转述，Amy不在这次提醒内。
recordSelection.quote: She reminded herself to check the label.

items.material: She reminded herself to check the label.
items.reason: She指女孩Mia，herself也指Mia，动作回到同一个人。可理解成Mia给自己留提醒。若Mia提醒的是另一位女孩，要根据语境用her；若提醒Ben则用him。不能因为Ben在转述就把反身代词指向Ben。
items.hint: She → herself：发出提醒与接受提醒的是同一人。

options.text: Mia reminded the same person: Mia.
options.reason: Mia既发出提醒，也接受提醒，herself与She指同一人。

options.text: Mia reminded Ben instead.
options.reason: Ben只是转述，不是题目里的被提醒者。

options.text: Use her even when it means the same Mia.
options.reason: 在这里明确表示提醒自己要用herself；her通常指另一位女性。

items.label: itself：旁边有人，也能自行关门
items.prompt: Try both closing methods. Keep Amy and Leo nearby. Which observed event matches by itself?

wordDecision.prompt: Try both closing methods. Keep Amy and Leo nearby. Which observed event matches by itself?

recordPaths.label: 保持旁观者不变，只比较关门原因
steps: release → automatic closer shuts the door

door.title: 松手以后，谁让门关上？
door.hint: 两人始终在旁边；先比较自动闭门与手推关门，再选符合原句的方式。
door.wrong: 原句说门自行关上。选自动闭门并松手观察；仅选方式或由人推关都不符合。

items.reason: The door closes by itself中的by itself表示自动、自行。试验里Amy和Leo一直在旁边；选择自动闭门后松手，门会由闭门器关上。换成手推方式，松手后门保持打开，要由人推才关上。判断的是关门原因，不是房间里有没有人。
items.hint: 先松手观察关门原因；旁边有人不等于有人推门。

options.text: A person pushes the door shut.
options.reason: 这次关门由人直接推动，不是自动关上。

options.text: The closer shuts the door without a person pushing it.
options.reason: by itself在这里表示门自动关上，不需要人推。

options.text: There can be no people anywhere near the door.
options.reason: 自动关门不要求附近没人；有人在旁边不等于有人在推门。

items.label: ourselves：自己做，不是只在旁边看
items.prompt: In scene A, two pupils make their own capes. In B, the teacher makes them while pupils only watch. Which fits the pupils’ words?

wordDecision.prompt: In scene A, two pupils make their own capes. In B, the teacher makes them while pupils only watch. Which fits the pupils’ words?

recordPaths.label: 先看谁动手，再看谁说we
steps: A: the two pupils do the making

art.alt: 左图两位学生在给紫色披风画星星、贴装饰；右图老师在制作披风，两位学生在旁边看。

evidence.caption: A中两位学生都在动手；题目明确他们是说We的同一组人。
B中老师在制作，学生只看；人物在场不能代替亲自动手。

items.reason: We与ourselves都指这两位学生，ourselves强调服装是他们亲手做的。材料、工具或别人提供的建议都不自动否定这种强调；关键是谁实际做。B的题设明确学生只看，制作由老师完成，所以不能用学生说We made them ourselves来概括。by ourselves可表示独自，与这里的强调用法要区分。
items.hint: We → ourselves；强调我们亲自做，词尾是selves。

options.text: A: the two speaking pupils do the making.
options.reason: 两位说话的学生亲自做，We与ourselves指同一组人。

options.text: B: the pupils only watch the teacher make them.
options.reason: B中完成制作的是老师，学生只是看，不符合学生说ourselves强调亲自做。

transfer.stem: Which notes correctly identify the invitation, the costume makers and the cause of the door closing?
transfer.passage:
SCHOOL PLAY PREPARATIONS
Ms Li tells Amy and Ben, “Help yourselves to some water.”
Amy says, “Ben and I made the costumes ourselves. Ms Li gave us the fabric, but she did not make the costumes.”
After the pupils walk through the door, it closes automatically. Mr Wu is nearby, but he does not touch it.

options.text: Both pupils may take water; Amy and Ben made the costumes; the door closes by itself despite Mr Wu being nearby.
Only Ms Li may take water; Amy and Ben made the costumes; the door closes by itself despite Mr Wu being nearby.
Both pupils may take water; Ms Li made the costumes because she gave the fabric; the door closes by itself.
Both pupils may take water; Amy and Ben made the costumes; Mr Wu must have pushed the door because he is nearby.

answer.display: Both pupils may take water; Amy and Ben made the costumes; the door closes by itself despite Mr Wu being nearby.

explanation.strategy: 分别找邀请面向谁、谁实际制作、谁让门关上；人物在场或提供材料都不等于完成那个动作。

steps.text: 老师对Amy和Ben两人说，yourselves指两位听者。Amy说Ben and I made the costumes，ourselves强调两人亲手做，老师提供布料不等于替他们制作。
steps.reason: 复数听者用yourselves；ourselves与说话的制作组是同一组人。

steps.text: 原文写门自动关上，Mr Wu没有碰门。即使他在旁边，门这次仍是by itself关上。
steps.reason: 判断的是关门原因；旁边有人不能推出有人推门。

distractors.reason: 邀请面向Amy和Ben，不是说话的Ms Li自己。
原文明说Ms Li只提供布料，没有制作服装；不能把材料提供者当成制作者。
Mr Wu虽在旁边，却没有碰门；原文明确自动关门，不能凭在场推断他推了门。

explanation.pitfall: 反身代词要跟着同一个人或小组；自动发生看原因，不看附近是否有人。
